benchmark.rule: The v5 benchmark series is a separate dataset under research/data/candles_v5, bounded at the v5 development cutoff. The v4 chain's benchmark dataset (research/data/candles_v3/BTCUSDT_1h_50d357b0cb2d6f8d.csv) ends with a candle closing at 2026-10-20T11:00:00Z, and 13 of its candles close after the v5 development cutoff, inside the open v2 confirmatory window, so it is not reused unchanged by the v5 chain.

code_hash_note: code_hash is the authorized value of record for the hashed set, cross-checked against research_state/campaign_authorization.json; canonical_source_digest is the portable identity of the tree.

confirmatory_window.note: No confirmatory-window candle has been read. The v5 confirmatory window starts after the v5 candidate freeze and needs at least 2160 closed hourly candles, so it cannot be evaluated in this session. Neither the v1 holdout, nor the v2, v3 or v4 confirmatory windows are reused, and no development candle closes after the preregistered development cutoff: the last development candle is the one that closes exactly at the cutoff, so it contains no instant inside any open confirmatory window.

window_membership_rule.rule: a candle is inside a confirmatory window when its close falls strictly after that window's start and before its end, regardless of which asset the candle belongs to; a candle that closes exactly at a window's start is development data
window_membership_rule.source_quote: Candles that close at or before confirmatory_window_start_utc are development data and may inform selection.

specification_flag.conflict: the flag says a candle whose close equals a window's start is inside that window, which would put the v5 boundary candle -- whose close is the v2 window's start -- inside the open v2 confirmatory window and contradict the v5 specification's own statement that no v5 development read can fall inside any open confirmatory window
specification_flag.resolution: the v5 chain follows the window-owning freeze; configs/research_v5.json is hash-bound and was not edited; the correction is a versioned amendment (BRAIN-022 section 6)

data_source.endpoint_policy: same-provider failover; selected endpoint recorded per asset

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest body with manifest_hash and snapshot_identity.data_manifest_hash removed, so that the manifest can carry the data-manifest hash without hashing itself into a cycle.

notes: v5 data manifest. Every accepted asset references an immutable canonical hourly CSV dataset under research/data/candles_v5. Synthetic records are never permitted. Nothing here is a research result: no grid, backtest, campaign or candidate selection has been run under v5.

prerequisite_status.note: configs/research_v5.json is immutable and still records P2 and P3 as OUTSTANDING; that statement describes the specification's own scope at freeze time and is not rewritten here. Flipping it requires a versioned amendment to the specification.

supersedes.note: The v4 data manifest is immutable and is not edited by this version; the v5 data manifest is the next batch below the recomputed v4 floor.

window_policy.boundary_convention: inclusive: the last development candle is the one that closes exactly at the development cutoff, and no candle that closes after the cutoff is read or accepted
window_policy.note: The candle window ends at the last fully closed hour at the preregistered development cutoff (configs/research_v5.json#holdout.development_cutoff_utc), so no v5 development dataset contains a candle that closes inside the open v2, v3 or v4 confirmatory window, and re-running the validation reproduces byte-identical datasets.
